# netbox_aggregates (Data Source)

Lists aggregate objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_aggregates" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, prefix, rir_id, rir_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `aggregates` (Attributes List) The matching aggregates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--aggregates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregates`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `date_added` (String) Date the aggregate was added, as YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps its value when removed from the configuration.
- `description` (String)
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `prefix` (String) The aggregate in CIDR notation, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8.
- `rir_id` (Number) Id of the RIR that allocated the aggregate.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
